24-Hour Diurnal PM2.5 (µg/m³) Profile During Active Haze Episodes

Why Central Singapore traps smoke overnight (02:00–08:00 SGT Urban Heat Island inversion) while Changi Point / Loyang flushes clean by 14:00 SGT.

1. Sumatra SW Monsoon Plume (Jun 2013)

When peatland fires ignite in Riau (Dumai/Bengkalis) under Southwest Monsoon winds (200°–250°), dense plumes cross the narrow 38 km Malacca Strait directly into Tuas, Jurong Island, and Boon Lay (D22). As the plume traverses 42 km of rough island terrain and vegetative canopy toward Changi Point and Pulau Ubin (D17), dry deposition and lateral Johor Strait dilution reduce ground PM2.5 by 35–50%.

2. Kalimantan SE/S Plume (1997, 2015, 2026)

During El Niño / positive Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD) years, southeasterly winds (130°–180°) carry aged smoke from Central/South Kalimantan and South Sumatra across the Singapore Strait into Sentosa, Telok Blangah (D04), Marina South (D01), and Marine Parade (D15). The northern lee of the island along the Johor Strait (Changi Point D17, Loyang D17, Pasir Ris Park D18, Coney Island D19, Sembawang D27) experiences clean northeast marine boundary-layer undercutting.

3. Urban Heat Island Nocturnal Trapping

NEA hourly PM2.5 and MSS radiosonde profiles show that Central Singapore (Orchard D09, Downtown Core D01, Newton D11, Toa Payoh D12) retains anthropogenic heat overnight, preventing convective boundary-layer collapse from dispersing fine particulates and causing a secondary PM2.5 spike between 01:00 and 08:30 SGT.

MODEL_TARGET: gemini-3.8-flash (High Effort / Deep Spatio-Temporal Reasoning)
ROLE: Principal Geospatial Atmospheric Scientist, Full-Stack GIS Engineer & Autonomous Browser/Computer-Use Agent
PROJECT: Singapore Haze Sanctuary Finder (1997–2026+ Spatio-Temporal Multi-Layer Fusion Engine)


1. MISSION OBJECTIVE:
Determine with mathematical, meteorological, and geospatial precision which exact part of Singapore is least affected by transboundary smoke haze—broken down by URA Planning Region (5), Planning Area (55), Subzone (332), Postal District (D01–D28), 2-Digit Postal Sector (01–82), and 6-Digit Postal Code—starting from the first day Singapore recorded an Unhealthy PSI reading (>100) on 18 September 1997 through every major and minor haze episode up to the present (including June 2013, Sep–Oct 2015, Sep 2019, Oct 2023, and Sep–Oct 2026), across both hourly diurnal cycles (1-hr PM2.5, wind vectors, boundary-layer height) and daily/24-hr rolling PSI records.

2. ORCHESTRATE IMPORTED SKILLS & MCP SERVERS:
- Skill `sg-haze-sanctuary-analyzer` + `sg-nea-haze-ingestor` (MCP `mcp-sg-haze-nea`): Ingest NEA v2 APIs (`psi`, `pm25`, `wind-direction`, `wind-speed`, `rainfall`, `relative-humidity`) & Collection 2215 + 1997–2013 archival CAMS/MERRA-2 reanalysis.
- Skill `sg-gis-subzone-interpolator` (MCP `mcp-sg-onemap-gis`): Spatial join URA Master Plan Subzones (`d_8594ae9ff96d0c708bc2af633048edfb`) with SLA OneMap 6-digit Postal Codes & Postal Districts D01–D28 in EPSG:3414 (SVY21).
- Skill `asmc-satellite-plume-tracker` (MCP `mcp-satellite-earth-engine`): Fuse MODIS MAIAC 1km AOD (`MCD19A2`), Sentinel-5P TROPOMI UVAI, and ASMC VIIRS fire hotspots.
- Skill `browser-computer-use-scraper` (MCP `mcp-playwright-computer-use`): Automate headless Chromium & multimodal vision inspection of `haze.gov.sg`, `asmc.asean.org`, and local WebGIS builds.
- Skill `github-pages-publisher`: Output production zero-backend WebGIS (`dist/index.html`) + `.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml`.
